MEET THE ARTIST / 선우정아

sunwoojunga

sunwoojunga is a singer, songwriter and producer whose work moves between pop and jazz. She was named Musician of the Year at the 2014 Korean Music Awards.

POP / JAZZ / 2019

Run with Me도망가자

Live performance

View release on Apple Music ↗

“Run with Me” appears on sunwoojunga’s 2019 album Serenade. Her own channel shares this performance from the SERENADE concert at Sogang University’s Mary Hall, giving the song a place on stage as well as on record.
